name: LVIS
description: A large-vocabulary instance segmentation dataset with object annotations across more than 1,000 categories, built on images from COCO. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Gupta, A., Dollar, P., & Girshick, R. (2019). LVIS: A Dataset for Large Vocabulary Instance Segmentation. IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR). https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00426

license.identifier: Custom LVIS license (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: LVIS uses its own dataset license, which is not a standard SPDX identifier. Review the license and underlying COCO image terms before use or redistribution; annotations and images may be subject to different conditions.
